terminalValues.matching: same t0, population chain keyHash (16 hex) = keyHash16, same CIK, |weight - register weight| <= 5e-9, member BOUNDED_EXIT*; exactly one member (fail closed otherwise); series replacement (step A) first

returnBasis: PRICE_RETURN both sides as V12/V13; documented terminal value = (cash + ratio x acquirer price at t1) / p0 - 1 (spx-terminal-rules 1.0.0), used in all four P5a scenarios; SPY_TR reference as V12
costs: none (index population returns, as V12 P5a)

weighting.EW_ALL: equal weight of all index members
weighting.CW_ALL: holdings weight (SPY) of all index members

EARLY.label: SECONDARY DESCRIPTIVE - all periods NOT_QUALIFIED in SPXPOP; levels not interpreted, only the deltas

P5a.ZERO: point convention: bounded exits at 0 % (last holdings price), ambiguous CA at the midpoint - NOT a bound
P5a.LOWER: all bounded exits at -100 %, ambiguous CA at the lower bound - gives the UPPER bound of the survivorship term (EW_WITH_H - EW_ALL) and the lower bound of EW_ALL/CW_ALL
P5a.FATE: exits by documented fate: takeover -> typical premium of documented takeovers (takeoverPremium.median), delisting/bankruptcy -> -100 %, index change -> population period return, unknown fate -> 0 %; ambiguous CA midpoint - evidence-based point estimate
P5a.UPPER: every bounded exit at max(takeover premium p75, population period return), ambiguous CA at the upper bound - gives the lower end of the survivorship term

terminal.S0: delisted series replacement at the last traded close

scope: Index population (S&P 500 members by SPY holdings). P5A tests only descriptive (V12 NW p of the period terms, no Holm); EARLY no test. Not a strategy, no alpha claim, no certification.
